# From Shattered Pixel Dungeon

`item_icons.png` is Shattered Pixel Dungeon's `core/src/main/assets/sprites/item_icons.png` (commit 57a4e06 of
https://github.com/00-Evan/shattered-pixel-dungeon), by Evan Debenham, released under the GNU GPL v3 like this port.
The backpack uses its potion and scroll icons to mark identified consumables (`watch/tools/convert_art.py` makes
`watch/resources/images/item_icons.png` from it).
